cases.required_disclosure: No valid delivery history is available; no numerical forecast was generated.

cases.condition: One observed delivery date with no known coverage for unobserved dates.
cases.required_disclosure: Observation coverage is unknown; a missing date is not assumed to be zero demand.

cases.condition: History has gaps inside its date span.
cases.required_disclosure: Calendar gaps require known coverage before they can be used as zero-demand buckets.

cases.condition: An order has duplicate original delivery evidence.
cases.required_disclosure: Duplicate delivery evidence prevents a trustworthy forecast input series.

cases.condition: A valid delivery has a current returned or refunded status.
cases.required_disclosure: Return-series treatment is not approved; no negative demand is inferred.

cases.condition: A complete candidate daily history has 55 consecutive buckets, 14 nonzero buckets, and 7 holdout buckets.
cases.required_disclosure: The selected candidate daily gate requires 56 complete consecutive buckets.

cases.condition: A complete candidate weekly history has 16 consecutive buckets, 7 nonzero buckets, and 4 holdout buckets.
cases.required_disclosure: The selected candidate weekly gate requires 8 nonzero buckets.
